## Message

```
error X18N2002: Resource could not be parsed: <detail>
  Fix the syntax error in the file.
```

The CLI prints the code, the message and a detail, such as a file name or a field. The hint follows on the next line. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

A locale file has a syntax error. The message names the file and the position.

1. Open the file and fix the syntax error.
2. Run `x18n check` again.

`x18n check` reports this as an `invalid-resource` diagnostic on the file.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
